artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(T^2, g)$ be the two-dimensional torus equipped with a smooth Riemannian metric $g$. The geodesic flow of $g$ is the Hamiltonian flow on the cotangent bundle $T^*T^2$ generated by the Hamiltonian $H(x,p) = \tfrac{1}{2} g^{ij}(x) p_i p_j$. A smooth function $F: T^*T^2 \to \mathbb{R}$ is called an integral of the geodesic flow if $\{F, H\} = 0$, where $\{\cdot,\cdot\}$ is the canonical Poisson bracket. The integral $F$ is said to be polynomial of degree $n$ in the momenta if, in any local cotangent coordinates, $F(x,p) = \sum_{i_1,\dots,i_n} a^{i_1\cdots i_n}(x)\, p_{i_1}\cdots p_{i_n} + (\text{lower-order terms in } p)$ with the top-degree part not identically zero. The integral is called nontrivial if it is functionally independent of $H$. A Killing vector field of $g$ is a vector field $X$ whose flow preserves $g$; equivalently, the function $p(X)$ on $T^*T^2$ is a linear-in-momenta integral of the geodesic flow.

Prove or disprove: if the geodesic flow of a Riemannian metric $g$ on $T^2$ admits a nontrivial integral that is polynomial of degree $3$ in the momenta, then $g$ admits a nontrivial Killing vector field.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture (often attributed to Bolotin–Kozlov and discussed by Kolokoltsov) remains open in full generality. Partial results exist: the conjecture has been verified for metrics close to a flat (or Liouville) metric, and recent works (e.g., on hydrodynamic-type systems and on third-rank Killing tensors on the 2-torus) provide partial progress, but no complete proof or counterexample is known.

status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture: existence of a degree-3 polynomial integral on T^2 implies existence of a Killing vector field; the conjecture has been verified for metrics close to certain integrable ones.

status_evidence.snippet: The paper studies degree-3 and degree-4 polynomial integrals of geodesic flows on the 2-torus via hydrodynamic-type systems, providing partial results without fully resolving the conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work provides partial progress but no full proof.

status_evidence.title: Killing tensor fields of third rank on a two-dimensional Riemannian torus
status_evidence.snippet: Studies rank-3 Killing tensor fields on a 2-torus, related to the cubic-integral conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Active research area; problem remains under investigation.
